item.title: Learning Curve
item.description: There is a learning curve in kayak fishing, starting with the basics like where to keep your paddle and how to handle a fish from the kayak. Over time, as you practice things like tying knots and fishing the same lure in your favorite spot, the curve begins to flatten out and success becomes more consistent. The post Learning Curve first appeared on Coastal Angler & The Angler Magazine.

item.title: The World’s Largest Arapaima Fishing Farm!
item.description: This video shows Jurassic Jewels, the largest Arapaima farm in North America! We were incredibly lucky to get up close with these monster fish—right here in Florida! Not only did we get an exclusive tour, but we also got the chance to fish a few of the ponds ourselves and it did not disappoint! From giant strikes to unforgettable catches, this was an adventure you won’t forget. The post The World’s Largest Arapaima Fishing Farm! first appeared on Coastal Angler & The Angler Magazine.
